en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Fazal, from Ibn Bukeyr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Eat from the birds what had a gizzard for it, or spur of a chick, or a craw’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn Faddal from ibn Bukayr who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Of birds you can eat whatever has gizzard or spur of the rooster or craws.’”
